 SECTIONS UFC today: What time does UFC 333 start for main card, prelims, early prelims? Fight card, key matches, venue By Debjit Sinha , Global Desk Last Updated: Oct 24, 2026, 07:37:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis UFC 333 today: UFC 333 is scheduled to take place on Saturday, October 24 at Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi.
 AP UFC 333 today: UFC featherweight champion Alexander Volkanovski. (AP photo) UFC featherweight champion Alexander Volkanovski faces unbeaten Movsar Evloev on Saturday in the main event of UFC 333 at Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi. Evloev has spent years imagining that meeting with 38-year-old Volkanovski in the octagon. His confidence rests on beating the champion at his best, rather than waiting for him to decline.
 UFC 333 fight card also features bantamweight champion Petr Yan defending his belt against Merab Dvalishvili in the third meeting between the rivals.
 UFC 333 Start Time 
UFC 333 is scheduled to take place on Saturday, October 24 at Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi. Early prelims are scheduled to start at 10 am (ET), prelims at 12 pm (ET). Main card will begin at 2 pm (ET).

For Volkanovski, extending his career has required adjustments to preparation. He credits his team with managing nutrition, recovery and training demands while preserving the intensity that makes him effective.
He acknowledges he is a different athlete than he was in his early 20s. He believes his explosiveness, preparation and understanding of the sport can still produce one of his best performances. The chance to overcome another opponent whose strengths have troubled other contenders motivates him.
Evloev brings a 20-0 professional record, including victories in all 10 of his UFC appearances. Each of those UFC wins has come by decision, a record of sustained success that has also brought scrutiny of his fighting style. Asked Wednesday about criticism that the sport also demands entertainment, Evloev pointed to the opportunity in front of him.

— UFC (@ufc) October 24, 2026 The challenger described the championship fight as the moment he had awaited throughout seven years with the promotion. He began preparing for Volkanovski long before the matchup was scheduled, when the champion became the opponent he expected to face to reach his goal. Their mutual respect has done little to soften their assessments of the matchup.
Volkanovski praised Evloev’s wrestling but said controlling him and damaging him present different problems. He expects attempts to land strikes on the ground to create opportunities for him to escape. At the final pre-fight press conference Thursday, Volkanovski said he intends to force Evloev to strike by preventing sustained ground control.
Evloev believes the cumulative demands of his approach will test that confidence. He acknowledged Volkanovski’s endurance but questioned whether previous opponents had imposed the kind of pressure he intends to bring. Volkanovski’s confidence rests on his ability to adjust through whatever challenges arise. Evloev believes he has prepared for precisely that opponent.
 Petr Yan vs Merab Dvalishvili 
Dvalishvili won their first meeting in March 2023. Yan reversed the result in December 2025, reclaiming the bantamweight championship and setting up Saturday’s deciding fight. Yan supplied some of Thursday’s sharper words, promising a methodical approach against the challenger nicknamed “The Machine.”
